card.name: Unit words right after a dose number
card.fires_on: The unit word or unit piece right after a dose number, such as Units, mcg, mg or mL. It also fires on the last digit of a decimal dose, in dosing text.

modes.label: Unit after number
modes.description: Units, mg, mcg or mL directly after a quantity, often just before a slash such as /mL or /kg.
modes.example: Cefaclor for Oral Suspension, USP 20<< mg>>/kg/day (Pharyngitis)

modes.label: Split unit pieces
modes.description: The unit is split up, and the pole fires on the piece 'mc' or 'g' of mcg, or on 'units' after 'international'.
modes.example: a final concentration of 20 or 25 mc<<g>>/mL is recommended.
